hero.title: STUDY MBBS IN NEPAL
hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in Nepal 2026–2027. No visa required for Indian citizens, identical MBBS syllabus, and close proximity to home.

overview: Nepal is the closest and most culturally familiar country for Indian students pursuing an MBBS degree. Colleges affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU) and Kathmandu University (KU) follow the Indian medical curriculum, allowing seamless preparation for NExT and USMLE.

faq.question: Is passport or visa required for Indian students in Nepal?
faq.answer: Indian citizens do not require a visa to study in Nepal. A valid Indian Passport or Voter ID card is sufficient for travel and admission.

faq.question: What is the admission procedure for MBBS in Nepal?
faq.answer: Admissions are conducted through the Medical Education Commission (MEC) Nepal, based either on NEET scores or the MEC entrance exam.
